title: Your MCU Likely Escaped the eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise
title_zh: 您的 MCU 可能未受 eMudhra 中间 CA 遭入侵事件影响

paragraphs.en: If you are a software engineer, or generally work in the tech industry, there is a good chance that you heard about the eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise that was disclosed yesterday (October 20, 2026). If you don’t, you may have noticed an uptick in software updates for various products that you use.
paragraphs.zh: 如果您是一名软件工程师，或通常在科技行业工作，那么您很有可能听说过昨天（2026年10月20日）披露的eMudhra中间CA失陷事件。 如果您没听说过，您可能也注意到自己使用的各类产品的软件更新有所增加。

sents.en: If you are a software engineer, or generally work in the tech industry, there is a good chance that you heard about the eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise that was disclosed yesterday (October 20, 2026).
sents.zh: 如果您是一名软件工程师，或通常在科技行业工作，那么您很有可能听说过昨天（2026年10月20日）披露的eMudhra中间CA失陷事件。

sents.en: If you don’t, you may have noticed an uptick in software updates for various products that you use.
sents.zh: 如果您没听说过，您可能也注意到自己使用的各类产品的软件更新有所增加。

paragraphs.en: I won’t go through the entire background of the situation as there are plenty of other posts, including the now public bug report from Mozilla, that describe the details of the compromise. However, I have had a number of folks reach out regarding the impact on IoT devices, specifically microcontroller (MCU) class devices. Some of them may have been motivated by the discourse around the compromise, such as Russ Cox’s Bluesky post , which included the following sentence.
paragraphs.zh: 我不会详细介绍事件的全部背景，因为已有许多其他文章，包括 Mozilla 现已公开的漏洞报告，都描述了这次入侵事件的细节。 不过，有不少人向我询问此事对物联网设备的影响，尤其是微控制器（MCU）类设备。 其中一些人可能是受到围绕这次入侵事件的讨论所驱动，例如 Russ Cox 在 Bluesky 上的帖子，其中包含了下面这句话。

sents.en: I won’t go through the entire background of the situation as there are plenty of other posts, including the now public bug report from Mozilla, that describe the details of the compromise.
sents.zh: 我不会详细介绍事件的全部背景，因为已有许多其他文章，包括 Mozilla 现已公开的漏洞报告，都描述了这次入侵事件的细节。

sents.en: However, I have had a number of folks reach out regarding the impact on IoT devices, specifically microcontroller (MCU) class devices.
sents.zh: 不过，有不少人向我询问此事对物联网设备的影响，尤其是微控制器（MCU）类设备。

sents.en: Some of them may have been motivated by the discourse around the compromise, such as Russ Cox’s Bluesky post , which included the following sentence.
sents.zh: 其中一些人可能是受到围绕这次入侵事件的讨论所驱动，例如 Russ Cox 在 Bluesky 上的帖子，其中包含了下面这句话。

paragraphs.en: IOT boxes that can’t or don’t update are now trivially MITM’able forever.
paragraphs.zh: 无法更新或不更新的物联网盒子现在永远都很容易被中间人攻击（MITM）。

paragraphs.en: Scott Helme’s post , which is at the top of Hacker News as of writing, also included a strong warning.
paragraphs.zh: Scott Helme 的文章在撰写本文时位列 Hacker News 首位，其中还包含了一个强烈的警告。

paragraphs.en: IoT, embedded and OT devices. Cameras, routers, cars, medical devices, smart appliances, payment terminals and industrial controllers phoning home for commands and updates. Their bundles are frozen until 2039, which is the “cannot be contained” point made real.
paragraphs.zh: 物联网、嵌入式与 OT 设备。 摄像头、路由器、汽车、医疗设备、智能家电、支付终端和工业控制器回连以获取命令与更新。 它们的软件包被冻结至 2039 年，这正是“无法控制”这一点的现实写照。

sents.en: IoT, embedded and OT devices.
sents.zh: 物联网、嵌入式与 OT 设备。

sents.en: Cameras, routers, cars, medical devices, smart appliances, payment terminals and industrial controllers phoning home for commands and updates.
sents.zh: 摄像头、路由器、汽车、医疗设备、智能家电、支付终端和工业控制器回连以获取命令与更新。

sents.en: Their bundles are frozen until 2039, which is the “cannot be contained” point made real.
sents.zh: 它们的软件包被冻结至 2039 年，这正是“无法控制”这一点的现实写照。

paragraphs.en: IoT is a tricky moniker these days. If you consider a single board computer, like a Raspberry Pi (or really anything running Linux), to be an IoT device, then there is a good chance that the aforementioned assertions are correct. You hopefully have an OTA update solution for these devices, and you should update them as soon as possible . On the other hand, if you have a fleet of MCUs, you probably are not (directly) impacted by the compromise. In order to understand why, it is necessary to have at least a cursory understanding of public key infrastructure (PKI), and specifically web PKI.
paragraphs.zh: 如今「物联网（IoT）」这个称谓有些微妙。 如果你把单板计算机（比如树莓派，或者任何运行 Linux 的设备）视为物联网设备，那么前述论断很可能成立。 你最好为这些设备准备一套 OTA 更新方案，并且应尽快进行更新。 另一方面，如果你拥有一批 MCU，那么你很可能（直接）不受此次入侵事件的影响。 要理解其中原因，至少需要对公钥基础设施（PKI），尤其是 Web PKI 有一个大致的了解。

sents.en: IoT is a tricky moniker these days.
sents.zh: 如今「物联网（IoT）」这个称谓有些微妙。

sents.en: If you consider a single board computer, like a Raspberry Pi (or really anything running Linux), to be an IoT device, then there is a good chance that the aforementioned assertions are correct.
sents.zh: 如果你把单板计算机（比如树莓派，或者任何运行 Linux 的设备）视为物联网设备，那么前述论断很可能成立。

sents.en: You hopefully have an OTA update solution for these devices, and you should update them as soon as possible .
sents.zh: 你最好为这些设备准备一套 OTA 更新方案，并且应尽快进行更新。

sents.en: On the other hand, if you have a fleet of MCUs, you probably are not (directly) impacted by the compromise.
sents.zh: 另一方面，如果你拥有一批 MCU，那么你很可能（直接）不受此次入侵事件的影响。

sents.en: In order to understand why, it is necessary to have at least a cursory understanding of public key infrastructure (PKI), and specifically web PKI.
sents.zh: 要理解其中原因，至少需要对公钥基础设施（PKI），尤其是 Web PKI 有一个大致的了解。

paragraphs.en: On the device you are reading this post on, there is a bundle of root certificate authority (CA) certificates. In fact, there are almost certainly multiple CA certificate bundles because your platform (i.e. operating system) ships a bundle, and your browser might as well. Mozilla has maintained a dedicated CA Certificate Program since the initial launch of Firefox , and Chrome followed suit when it announced its root program in 2022 . These root certificates are “trust anchors” that allow internet services that you communicate with to prove that they are who they say they are. Every website that you navigate to over HTTPS in your browser is verifying its identity by presenting one or more certificates that can be traced back to one of the CA certificates in the client’s bundle. For example, when you visited this blog post, the server that hosts it presented your browser with the following certificate chain.
paragraphs.zh: 在你阅读这篇文章的设备上，存储着一套根证书颁发机构（CA）证书。 事实上，你几乎肯定拥有多套 CA 证书包，因为你的平台（即操作系统）自带一套证书包，而你的浏览器可能也自带一套。 自 Firefox 最初发布以来，Mozilla 就一直维护着一个专门的 CA 证书计划，而 Chrome 也在 2022 年宣布其根证书计划时紧随其后。 这些根证书是「信任锚」，让你所通信的互联网服务能够证明它们确实是其声称的身份。 你在浏览器中通过 HTTPS 访问的每个网站，都会通过出示一个或多个证书来验证自己的身份，这些证书可以追溯到客户端证书包中的某一张 CA 证书。 例如，当你访问这篇博文时，托管它的服务器向你的浏览器出示了如下的证书链。

sents.en: On the device you are reading this post on, there is a bundle of root certificate authority (CA) certificates.
sents.zh: 在你阅读这篇文章的设备上，存储着一套根证书颁发机构（CA）证书。

sents.en: In fact, there are almost certainly multiple CA certificate bundles because your platform (i.e. operating system) ships a bundle, and your browser might as well.
sents.zh: 事实上，你几乎肯定拥有多套 CA 证书包，因为你的平台（即操作系统）自带一套证书包，而你的浏览器可能也自带一套。

sents.en: Mozilla has maintained a dedicated CA Certificate Program since the initial launch of Firefox , and Chrome followed suit when it announced its root program in 2022 .
sents.zh: 自 Firefox 最初发布以来，Mozilla 就一直维护着一个专门的 CA 证书计划，而 Chrome 也在 2022 年宣布其根证书计划时紧随其后。

sents.en: These root certificates are “trust anchors” that allow internet services that you communicate with to prove that they are who they say they are.
sents.zh: 这些根证书是「信任锚」，让你所通信的互联网服务能够证明它们确实是其声称的身份。

sents.en: Every website that you navigate to over HTTPS in your browser is verifying its identity by presenting one or more certificates that can be traced back to one of the CA certificates in the client’s bundle.
sents.zh: 你在浏览器中通过 HTTPS 访问的每个网站，都会通过出示一个或多个证书来验证自己的身份，这些证书可以追溯到客户端证书包中的某一张 CA 证书。

sents.en: For example, when you visited this blog post, the server that hosts it presented your browser with the following certificate chain.
sents.zh: 例如，当你访问这篇博文时，托管它的服务器向你的浏览器出示了如下的证书链。

paragraphs.en: Certificate chain 0 s:CN=danielmangum.com i:C=US, O=Let's Encrypt, CN=YR1 a:PKEY: RSA, 2048 (bit); sigalg: sha256WithRSAEncryption v:NotBefore: Aug 24 08:02:52 2026 GMT; NotAfter: Nov 22 08:02:51 2026 GMT 1 s:C=US, O=Let's Encrypt, CN=YR1 i:C=US, O=ISRG, CN=Root YR a:PKEY: RSA, 2048 (bit); sigalg: sha256WithRSAEncryption v:NotBefore: Sep 3 00:00:00 2025 GMT; NotAfter: Sep 2 23:59:59 2028 GMT 2 s:C=US, O=ISRG, CN=Root YR i:C=US, O=Internet Security Research Group, CN=ISRG Root X1 a:PKEY: RSA, 4096 (bit); sigalg: sha256WithRSAEncryption v:NotBefore: May 13 00:00:00 2026 GMT; NotAfter: Sep 2 23:59:59 2032 GMT You can use openssl s_client -showcerts -verify 5 -connect danielmangum.com:443 to see it for yourself.
paragraphs.zh: 证书链 0 s:CN=danielmangum.com i:C=US, O=Let's Encrypt, CN=YR1 a:PKEY: RSA, 2048 (bit); sigalg: sha256WithRSAEncryption v:NotBefore: 2026年8月24日 08:02:52 GMT; NotAfter: 2026年11月22日 08:02:51 GMT 1 s:C=US, O=Let's Encrypt, CN=YR1 i:C=US, O=ISRG, CN=Root YR a:PKEY: RSA, 2048 (bit); sigalg: sha256WithRSAEncryption v:NotBefore: 2025年9月3日 00:00:00 GMT; NotAfter: 2028年9月2日 23:59:59 GMT 2 s:C=US, O=ISRG, CN=Root YR i:C=US, O=Internet Security Research Group, CN=ISRG Root X1 a:PKEY: RSA, 4096 (bit); sigalg: sha256WithRSAEncryption v:NotBefore: 2026年5月13日 00:00:00 GMT; NotAfter: 2032年9月2日 23:59:59 GMT 你可以使用 openssl s_client -showcerts -verify 5 -connect danielmangum.com:443 亲自查看。

paragraphs.en: The first certificate ( danielmangum.com ) specifies that it is signed by the second ( YR1 ), and the second by the third ( Root YR ). The third specifies its issuer as ISRG Root X1 , which is the very popular Let’s Encrypt root CA certificate that is present in every major trust store . Because ISRG Root X1 is present in your trust store and the server sent you the necessary set of certificates to establish a chain of trust to that trusted root, you can be confident that you are in fact talking to danielmangum.com . Let’s Encrypt has a helpful diagram describing this chain of trust.
paragraphs.zh: 第一个证书（danielmangum.com）指明它由第二个证书（YR1）签署，而第二个证书由第三个证书（Root YR）签署。 第三个证书指明其签发者为 ISRG Root X1，也就是非常流行的 Let's Encrypt 根 CA 证书，它存在于每个主要的信任库中。 由于 ISRG Root X1 存在于你的信任库中，并且服务器向你发送了建立通往该受信任根的信任链所需的一整套证书，你可以确信自己实际上是在与 danielmangum.com 通信。 Let's Encrypt 提供了一张描述这条信任链的有用示意图。

sents.en: The first certificate ( danielmangum.com ) specifies that it is signed by the second ( YR1 ), and the second by the third ( Root YR ).
sents.zh: 第一个证书（danielmangum.com）指明它由第二个证书（YR1）签署，而第二个证书由第三个证书（Root YR）签署。

sents.en: The third specifies its issuer as ISRG Root X1 , which is the very popular Let’s Encrypt root CA certificate that is present in every major trust store .
sents.zh: 第三个证书指明其签发者为 ISRG Root X1，也就是非常流行的 Let's Encrypt 根 CA 证书，它存在于每个主要的信任库中。

sents.en: Because ISRG Root X1 is present in your trust store and the server sent you the necessary set of certificates to establish a chain of trust to that trusted root, you can be confident that you are in fact talking to danielmangum.com .
sents.zh: 由于 ISRG Root X1 存在于你的信任库中，并且服务器向你发送了建立通往该受信任根的信任链所需的一整套证书，你可以确信自己实际上是在与 danielmangum.com 通信。

sents.en: Let’s Encrypt has a helpful diagram describing this chain of trust.
sents.zh: Let's Encrypt 提供了一张描述这条信任链的有用示意图。

paragraphs.en: While establishing a secure connection to this site specifically may not be critical, this system is what allows us to perform sensitive operations, such as sending private messages, managing our bank accounts, and paying for items with a credit card without fear of an attacker stealing the data. In the eMudhra compromise, eight intermediate CA certificates, similar to Root YR and YR1 above, had their private keys accessible on the public internet. The private keys also happened to be extremely weak, with the top 376 bits of the P-384 keys being all zeroes. One of the private keys was literally the number 4 ( 00000100 ). This means that someone with even moderate technical capabilities could easily issue themselves a leaf certificate (like danielmangum.com ), then present the leaf and the intermediate, and it would be trusted by every trust store that included eMudhra’s root CA certificate. Unfortunately, that included all the same major root programs.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然专门与这个网站建立安全连接可能并不关键，但正是这套系统让我们能够执行敏感操作，例如发送私信、管理银行账户，以及用信用卡支付商品，而不必担心攻击者窃取数据。 在 eMudhra 入侵事件中，八个与上述 Root YR 和 YR1 类似的中间 CA 证书，其私钥竟能在公共互联网上被访问到。 这些私钥还恰好极其薄弱，P-384 密钥最高 376 位全为零。 其中一把私钥干脆就是数字 4（00000100）。 这意味着哪怕只有中等技术水平的人，也能轻松给自己签发一个叶证书（例如 danielmangum.com），然后出示该叶证书和中间证书，任何包含了 eMudhra 根 CA 证书的信任库都会信任它。 不幸的是，这包括了所有同样的主流根证书计划。

sents.en: While establishing a secure connection to this site specifically may not be critical, this system is what allows us to perform sensitive operations, such as sending private messages, managing our bank accounts, and paying for items with a credit card without fear of an attacker stealing the data.
sents.zh: 虽然专门与这个网站建立安全连接可能并不关键，但正是这套系统让我们能够执行敏感操作，例如发送私信、管理银行账户，以及用信用卡支付商品，而不必担心攻击者窃取数据。

sents.en: In the eMudhra compromise, eight intermediate CA certificates, similar to Root YR and YR1 above, had their private keys accessible on the public internet.
sents.zh: 在 eMudhra 入侵事件中，八个与上述 Root YR 和 YR1 类似的中间 CA 证书，其私钥竟能在公共互联网上被访问到。

sents.en: The private keys also happened to be extremely weak, with the top 376 bits of the P-384 keys being all zeroes.
sents.zh: 这些私钥还恰好极其薄弱，P-384 密钥最高 376 位全为零。

sents.en: One of the private keys was literally the number 4 ( 00000100 ).
sents.zh: 其中一把私钥干脆就是数字 4（00000100）。

sents.en: This means that someone with even moderate technical capabilities could easily issue themselves a leaf certificate (like danielmangum.com ), then present the leaf and the intermediate, and it would be trusted by every trust store that included eMudhra’s root CA certificate.
sents.zh: 这意味着哪怕只有中等技术水平的人，也能轻松给自己签发一个叶证书（例如 danielmangum.com），然后出示该叶证书和中间证书，任何包含了 eMudhra 根 CA 证书的信任库都会信任它。

sents.en: Unfortunately, that included all the same major root programs.
sents.zh: 不幸的是，这包括了所有同样的主流根证书计划。

paragraphs.en: Some clients, namely browsers, also require that a leaf certificate be included in a certificate transparency (CT) log in order to be trusted. This has allowed for the major browsers to assert with relative confidence that users of their software were not impacted, whereas other software very well may have been.
paragraphs.zh: 某些客户端，即浏览器，还要求叶子证书被包含在证书透明度（CT）日志中才能被信任。 这使得各大浏览器能够相对自信地断言其软件的用户未受影响，而其他软件则很可能受到了影响。

sents.en: Some clients, namely browsers, also require that a leaf certificate be included in a certificate transparency (CT) log in order to be trusted.
sents.zh: 某些客户端，即浏览器，还要求叶子证书被包含在证书透明度（CT）日志中才能被信任。

sents.en: This has allowed for the major browsers to assert with relative confidence that users of their software were not impacted, whereas other software very well may have been.
sents.zh: 这使得各大浏览器能够相对自信地断言其软件的用户未受影响，而其他软件则很可能受到了影响。

paragraphs.en: The private keys for the intermediate certificates were incorrectly generated by the CA. This means that anyone can recover them from the certificates.
paragraphs.zh: 中间证书的私钥被证书颁发机构（CA）错误地生成。 这意味着任何人都可以从证书中恢复这些私钥。

sents.en: The private keys for the intermediate certificates were incorrectly generated by the CA.
sents.zh: 中间证书的私钥被证书颁发机构（CA）错误地生成。

sents.en: This means that anyone can recover them from the certificates.
sents.zh: 这意味着任何人都可以从证书中恢复这些私钥。

paragraphs.en: This would have been possible since the certificates were created in April 2025. There are no entries in the certificate transparency logs for these intermediates in that period, indicating that CT-enforcing clients like Firefox, Chrome, Edge and Safari could not have been attacked.
paragraphs.zh: 这是有可能发生的，因为这些证书创建于 2025 年 4 月。 在该时间段内，证书透明度日志中没有这些中间证书的记录，这表明强制执行证书透明度的客户端（如 Firefox、Chrome、Edge 和 Safari）不可能受到攻击。

sents.en: This would have been possible since the certificates were created in April 2025.
sents.zh: 这是有可能发生的，因为这些证书创建于 2025 年 4 月。

sents.en: There are no entries in the certificate transparency logs for these intermediates in that period, indicating that CT-enforcing clients like Firefox, Chrome, Edge and Safari could not have been attacked.
sents.zh: 在该时间段内，证书透明度日志中没有这些中间证书的记录，这表明强制执行证书透明度的客户端（如 Firefox、Chrome、Edge 和 Safari）不可能受到攻击。

paragraphs.en: However, many clients outside of the browser ecosystem do not enforce Certificate Transparency. We do not know if attackers exploited the flawed key generation to target these clients.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，浏览器生态系统之外的许多客户端并不强制执行证书透明度。 我们不知道攻击者是否利用了有缺陷的密钥生成过程来攻击这些客户端。

sents.en: However, many clients outside of the browser ecosystem do not enforce Certificate Transparency.
sents.zh: 然而，浏览器生态系统之外的许多客户端并不强制执行证书透明度。

sents.en: We do not know if attackers exploited the flawed key generation to target these clients.
sents.zh: 我们不知道攻击者是否利用了有缺陷的密钥生成过程来攻击这些客户端。

paragraphs.en: The disclosure of this compromise led to a mad dash across programming languages , developer tools , OS packages , and essentially any software involved with establishing a TLS connection , to either filter for these compromised intermediates, or reject the eMudhra root CA certificate entirely. To say the issue is widespread would be an understatement.
paragraphs.zh: 这一入侵事件的披露，引发了各编程语言、开发者工具、操作系统软件包乃至几乎所有涉及建立 TLS 连接的软件的疯狂行动，要么过滤掉这些被入侵的中间证书，要么彻底拒绝 eMudhra 根 CA 证书。 说这个问题影响广泛都算是轻描淡写了。

sents.en: The disclosure of this compromise led to a mad dash across programming languages , developer tools , OS packages , and essentially any software involved with establishing a TLS connection , to either filter for these compromised intermediates, or reject the eMudhra root CA certificate entirely.
sents.zh: 这一入侵事件的披露，引发了各编程语言、开发者工具、操作系统软件包乃至几乎所有涉及建立 TLS 连接的软件的疯狂行动，要么过滤掉这些被入侵的中间证书，要么彻底拒绝 eMudhra 根 CA 证书。

sents.en: To say the issue is widespread would be an understatement.
sents.zh: 说这个问题影响广泛都算是轻描淡写了。

paragraphs.en: So why are MCUs unlikely to be impacted? In short, because of resource constraints. While including a bundle, or multiple bundles, of X.509 certificates on a server, desktop machine, or even a single board computer has trivial impact (what’s a few kilobytes among friends?), we have to be much more judicious when targeting devices that often have less than, sometimes much less than, 1 MB of non-volatile storage. Furthermore, rather than relying on an OS or browser vendor to go through the painstaking process of evaluating and monitoring candidate root CA certificates, we are typically responsible for the entire system, either building bare metal applications or leveraging lightweight Real Time Operating Systems (RTOS).
paragraphs.zh: 那么，为什么 MCU 不太可能受到影响呢？ 简而言之，是因为资源受限。 虽然在服务器、台式机，甚至单板计算机上包含一组或多组 X.509 证书的影响微不足道（几个千字节在朋友之间算得了什么？），但当目标是那些非易失性存储空间通常小于、有时甚至远小于 1 MB 的设备时，我们就必须更加谨慎。 此外，我们通常要负责整个系统——无论是构建裸机应用程序，还是利用轻量级实时操作系统（RTOS）——而不是依赖操作系统或浏览器供应商去经历评估和监控候选根 CA 证书这一繁琐的过程。

sents.en: So why are MCUs unlikely to be impacted?
sents.zh: 那么，为什么 MCU 不太可能受到影响呢？

sents.en: Furthermore, rather than relying on an OS or browser vendor to go through the painstaking process of evaluating and monitoring candidate root CA certificates, we are typically responsible for the entire system, either building bare metal applications or leveraging lightweight Real Time Operating Systems (RTOS).
sents.zh: 此外，我们通常要负责整个系统——无论是构建裸机应用程序，还是利用轻量级实时操作系统（RTOS）——而不是依赖操作系统或浏览器供应商去经历评估和监控候选根 CA 证书这一繁琐的过程。

paragraphs.en: For example, the HTTP GET sample in the Zephyr RTOS connects to google.com . Its trust chain looks as follows.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，Zephyr RTOS 中的 HTTP GET 示例会连接到 google.com。 其信任链如下所示。

sents.en: For example, the HTTP GET sample in the Zephyr RTOS connects to google.com .
sents.zh: 例如，Zephyr RTOS 中的 HTTP GET 示例会连接到 google.com。

sents.en: Its trust chain looks as follows.
sents.zh: 其信任链如下所示。

paragraphs.en: Certificate chain 0 s:CN=*.google.com i:C=US, O=Google Trust Services, CN=WE2 a:PKEY: EC, (prime256v1); sigalg: ecdsa-with-SHA256 v:NotBefore: Sep 28 18:38:33 2026 GMT; NotAfter: Dec 21 18:38:32 2026 GMT 1 s:C=US, O=Google Trust Services, CN=WE2 i:C=US, O=Google Trust Services LLC, CN=GTS Root R4 a:PKEY: EC, (prime256v1); sigalg: ecdsa-with-SHA384 v:NotBefore: Dec 13 09:00:00 2023 GMT; NotAfter: Feb 20 14:00:00 2029 GMT 2 s:C=US, O=Google Trust Services LLC, CN=GTS Root R4 i:C=BE, O=GlobalSign nv-sa, OU=Root CA, CN=GlobalSign Root CA a:PKEY: EC, (secp384r1); sigalg: sha256WithRSAEncryption v:NotBefore: Nov 15 03:43:21 2023 GMT; NotAfter: Jan 28 00:00:42 2028 GMT Rather than having a generic set of root CA certificates that covers the majority of the internet, the sample only includes the single root CA certificate ( GlobalSign R1 ) that is needed to verify google.com . It is nearly 1 KB (DER encoded) on its own, but the size of the certificate is not the only consideration. Enabling all signing algorithms, curves, and hashing algorithms used throughout the certificate chain can have a significant impact on code size as well. Additionally, buffer sizes must be configured to accommodate the full chain; the longer the chain, the more memory that needs to be allocated.
paragraphs.zh: 证书链 0 s:CN=*.google.com i:C=US, O=Google Trust Services, CN=WE2 a:PKEY: EC, (prime256v1); sigalg: ecdsa-with-SHA256 v:NotBefore: Sep 28 18:38:33 2026 GMT; NotAfter: Dec 21 18:38:32 2026 GMT 1 s:C=US, O=Google Trust Services, CN=WE2 i:C=US, O=Google Trust Services LLC, CN=GTS Root R4 a:PKEY: EC, (prime256v1); sigalg: ecdsa-with-SHA384 v:NotBefore: Dec 13 09:00:00 2023 GMT; NotAfter: Feb 20 14:00:00 2029 GMT 2 s:C=US, O=Google Trust Services LLC, CN=GTS Root R4 i:C=BE, O=GlobalSign nv-sa, OU=Root CA, CN=GlobalSign Root CA a:PKEY: EC, (secp384r1); sigalg: sha256WithRSAEncryption v:NotBefore: Nov 15 03:43:21 2023 GMT; NotAfter: Jan 28 00:00:42 2028 GMT 该示例没有使用一套覆盖互联网上大多数站点的通用根 CA 证书，而是只包含了验证 google.com 所需的那一个根 CA 证书（GlobalSign R1）。 仅这一个证书本身就有近 1 KB（DER 编码），而且证书大小并不是唯一的考量因素。 启用整条证书链中用到的所有签名算法、曲线和哈希算法，同样会对代码大小产生显著影响。 此外，还必须配置缓冲区大小以容纳完整的证书链；证书链越长，需要分配的内存就越多。

paragraphs.en: These constraints can lead to frustrating errors and complex debugging sessions. However, there is something to be said for building a system that is only focused on accomplishing a fixed, well defined set of tasks. When situations like the eMudhra compromise arise, I find myself appreciating the inherent limitations of these devices and the intention that goes into building the firmware that runs on them. Perhaps this event is an opportunity for us to evaluate whether some of that intention can be applied in other domains.
paragraphs.zh: 这些约束可能导致令人沮丧的错误和复杂的调试过程。 然而，构建一个仅专注于完成一组固定的、定义明确的任务的系统，也有其可取之处。 当像 eMudhra 入侵事件这样的情况出现时，我发现自己会更加欣赏这些设备固有的局限性，以及构建其上运行固件时所投入的用心。 也许这一事件是一个契机，让我们可以评估是否能把这种用心应用到其他领域。

sents.en: Perhaps this event is an opportunity for us to evaluate whether some of that intention can be applied in other domains.
sents.zh: 也许这一事件是一个契机，让我们可以评估是否能把这种用心应用到其他领域。

paragraphs.en: Unless your MCU needs to connect to a server that uses a chain of trust rooted in an eMudhra root CA certificate, and you included it (or the Sectigo root CA certfificate used for cross-signing ) in your firmware, your devices are likely safe from this specific vulnerability. Now all you have to do is make sure that you patch all of your CI environments, developer tooling, cloud services, and productivity software.
paragraphs.zh: 除非你的 MCU 需要连接到一个使用以 eMudhra 根 CA 证书为信任链根的服务器，并且你已将该证书（或用于交叉签名的 Sectigo 根 CA 证书）包含在固件中，否则你的设备很可能不会受到这个特定漏洞的影响。 现在你所要做的就是确保给所有的 CI 环境、开发者工具、云服务和办公软件打上补丁。
